question: Where is the Kolleru Lake situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kolleru Lake** is one of the largest freshwater lakes in India.
 
• It is located in the state of **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• The lake is situated between the deltas of the Godavari and Krishna rivers.
 
• Kolleru Lake serves as a **natural flood-balancing reservoir **for these rivers.
 
• The lake is an important habitat for a variety of **migratory birds **and is a designated wetland under the Ramsar Convention.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ecological Significance**

 
 
• Kolleru Lake is a vital ecosystem that supports a rich biodiversity of flora and fauna.
 
• The lake is home to several species of fish, amphibians, and reptiles.
 
• It also serves as a breeding ground for many bird species, making it an important site for birdwatching and ornithological studies.
 
 
 
• **Human Impact and Conservation**
 
 
• Over the years, the lake has faced threats from human activities such as agriculture, aquaculture, and urbanization.
 
• Efforts are being made to conserve and restore the lake's natural habitat through various government and non-government initiatives.
 
• The Andhra Pradesh government has undertaken several measures to regulate fishing and farming activities in and around the lake to preserve its ecological balance.
